lines.text: Excuse me, is there a pharmacy near here?
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: Yes, there is one next to the bakery.
lines.speaker: Leo

lines.text: Is the bakery on this side of the street?
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: No, it's across the street, beside the bank.
lines.speaker: Leo

lines.text: Is that the bank with the blue door?
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: Yes, that's it. The bakery has a yellow sign.
lines.speaker: Leo

lines.text: Great, so the pharmacy is next to the bakery.
lines.speaker: Mina

lines.text: That's right. You can see it from here.
lines.speaker: Leo
